title: Crusial bugs in 3.1.0
symptom: App crashes constantly when set to light skin. Also a new blue banner below the buttons is annoying and stays in the middle.
fix: Remove AAPS, reinstall and reimport settings. After complete removal, install 3.1.0 again; the default dark theme works. Alternatively, downgrade to 3.0.0.1.
evidence_quote: a hotfix is coming the next few days . Until it’s available, remove AApS, reinstall and reimport your settings
